highlights.en:
3S was the setup we actually traded together, so it
was the easiest to teach.

the Playbook is the short road and the 6 & 6 is
the long one.
Handling them carefully was a duty.

FireStarter went from a trade in our emails to a
method on paper, with every number checked against its own rules.

it saved what Michael had spent years unpacking, so a
new student would not need years.

The
courses reach the student who learns by watching first.

The work no longer lives only in our
inboxes.

None of it would exist if Michael had kept trying to
draw his own diagrams. None of it would make sense if he had not first
spent eleven years with Charlie.

hard work can make you a state champion; only
the wider arena tells you where you really stand.

someone once gave you a moment you never forgot;
when your turn comes, give it back.

mindmap.note_en: The Simple System Setup, the 6 & 6, Charlie's Notebooks, FireStarter.
mindmap.note_ar: الـ 3S والـ 6 & 6 وNotebooks لـ Charlie وFireStarter.

children.note_en: One setup, start to finish, with entries and a target box; our everyday language.
children.note_ar: setup واحد من البداية إلى النهاية بنقاط دخول وصندوق هدف؛ لغتنا اليومية.

children.note_en: It was the setup we actually traded together.
children.note_ar: كان الـ setup الذي تداولناه معًا فعلًا.

children.note_en: Six swings off the G-Spot graded by six parameters; the deep study behind Molokai.
children.note_ar: ستة swings من الـ G-Spot تُقيَّم بستة parameters؛ الدراسة العميقة وراء Molokai.

children.en: Lesson: short road vs long road
children.note_en: Playbook is the short road, 6 & 6 the long one; readers choose.
children.note_ar: الـ Playbook الطريق القصير والـ 6 & 6 الطويل؛ والقارئ يختار.

children.note_en: Three books from 2016 edited by Michael: propagation, Crossover Point, Landing Area.
children.note_ar: ثلاثة كتب من 2016 حرّرها Michael: propagation وCrossover Point وLanding Area.

children.note_en: Handling them carefully was a duty.
Short-term trade off the end of a Jumbo swing; I built a 29-page, 32-figure companion.
children.note_ar: صفقة قصيرة الأمد من نهاية Jumbo swing؛ وبنيتُ كتابًا مرافقًا من 29 صفحة و32 شكلًا.

children.note_en: Every number checked against its own rules.

mindmap.note_en: Goodmanisms series, five Udemy courses, and the website that gathers it all.
mindmap.note_ar: سلسلة Goodmanisms وخمس دورات على Udemy والموقع الذي يجمع كل شيء.

children.note_en: Charlie's sayings illustrated as a course of seven rules for trading discipline.
children.note_ar: أقوال Charlie مصوّرة في دورة من سبع قواعد لانضباط التداول.

children.note_en: A new student need not spend years.
children.note_ar: لا يحتاج الطالب الجديد إلى سنوات.

children.note_en: Five courses: 1-2-3, Journal and Expectancy, Trade Management, 3-C, 3S.
children.note_ar: خمس دورات: الـ 1-2-3 والـ Journal والـ Expectancy وTrade Management والـ 3-C والـ 3S.

children.note_en: Courses reach students who learn by watching first.
children.note_ar: تصل الدورات إلى من يتعلم بالمشاهدة أولًا.

children.note_en: Rebuilt in September 2026, with a cover for every book.
children.note_ar: أُعيد بناؤه في September 2026 مع غلاف لكل كتاب.

children.en: Lesson: work no longer in inboxes
children.note_en: Charlie's method, Michael's books and my drawings sit side by side.
children.note_ar: تجتمع طريقة Charlie وكتب Michael ورسوماتي معًا.

mindmap.note_en: 2024 ideas, 2025 writing, 2026 building; my part was giving the work a usable form.
mindmap.note_ar: 2024 أفكار، 2025 كتابة، 2026 بناء؛ ودوري منح العمل شكلًا قابلًا للاستخدام.

children.note_en: Without Michael's eleven years with Charlie it would make no sense; without the diagrams it would not exist.
children.note_ar: بدون سنوات Michael الإحدى عشرة مع Charlie لا معنى له، وبدون الرسوم لا وجود له.

mindmap.note_en: Michael's promise: 'someday you tell your students Archer stories'; short, funny stories with a lesson at the end.
mindmap.note_ar: وعد Michael: ستروي يومًا لطلابك حكايات Archer؛ حكايات قصيرة طريفة بدرس في آخرها.

children.note_en: Won the Colorado Junior State Championship, then was beaten by a 13-year-old in France.
children.note_ar: فاز ببطولة Colorado Junior ثم هزمه فتى في الثالثة عشرة في فرنسا.

children.note_en: Only the wider arena shows your real standing; keep size modest.
children.note_ar: الساحة الأوسع وحدها تُظهر مكانتك؛ فأبقِ الحجم متواضعًا.

children.note_en: A stranger's ride in a Corvette, repaid 25 years later with a Ferrari ride for a boy.
children.note_ar: جولة غريب في Corvette ردّها بعد 25 عامًا بجولة Ferrari لولد.

children.note_en: Give back the moment someone gave you.
